text: Your Figma prototype can be real code now, sitting right on the canvas. It's called code layers, and it just opened up in beta. Look for the new Code icon in the toolbar. Select a frame, ask the Figma agent to turn it into a code layer, and you get a working interface. Hovers, inputs and scrolling actually work. Need a change? Prompt the agent, or edit the code yourself. And the best part: Extract designs pulls a screen, or a whole flow, back out as editable Figma layers. On paid plans it's free until November fourth, so try it this week. You design, the agent builds. I'll keep testing, you just subscribe.
